purpose: Teach: 公債/渡航/出国/通院/含有/取り扱っ/照会/婚姻

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費に公債収入を含めて考えろ
lines.en: Ren — factor in government bond income when you're working through the research budget.
lines.style: Quiet directive. Sets expectation without fanfare. Measured pace. The tone of someone used to being understood. Brief pause after the name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外渡航のための学会発表準備をしております
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm preparing for a conference presentation for the overseas travel portion.
lines.style: Formal but earnest. Slight uptick of attention after the affirmative. Careful articulation. Respectful distance without stiffness. Slight trailing breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、留学出国の準備、確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — verify the preparations for your study abroad departure.
lines.style: Steady, authoritative. Light emphasis on the verb. No warmth, no coldness — the clarity of an exacting mentor. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究者が通院していらっしゃるので配慮します
lines.en: Yes, sir. My research partner has been in and out of the hospital, so I'm taking that into account.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before answering. Respectful tone that carries a note of genuine care beneath the formality. Careful, measured delivery. Slight soften on the final clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文に成分の含有量を明記しろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure the paper explicitly states the concentration levels of each component.
lines.style: Direct, non-negotiable. Crisp attack on the verb. Composed but firm. The instruction of someone who has seen papers undone by missing precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究データは厳重に取り扱っております
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm handling the research data with strict protocols.
lines.style: Prompt, assured. No hesitation. Quiet confidence in the statement. Formal register held steady. Slight emphasis on 'strict' to show diligence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、引用元への照会も忘れるな
lines.en: Ren — don't forget to follow up with the original sources on your citations.
lines.style: Final instruction, delivered with careful weight. Slight emphasis on the negation. A parting reminder that assumes he'll remember it. Calm, not patronising.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。婚姻届を出した先輩、お祝いいたしました
lines.en: Yes, sir. And I wanted to say — we celebrated when my senior colleague filed his marriage notification.
lines.style: Formal affirmative that softens into something warmer at the close. Small, genuine smile beneath the politeness. Quiet sincerity on the personal note. Trailing off gently, as if to include him in the occasion without presuming.
